Good national coverage: sweden-law holds the consolidated current text (SFST, 'i lydelse t.o.m. SFS ...', not the as-first-published SFS print) of 5,303 statutes in force and 5,813 repealed ones, including all 10 essentials, and both spot checks pass. It has no earlier versions, no case law at all (no Högsta domstolen or Högsta förvaltningsdomstolen repository exists), no regional law, and the chart's 72% 'sourced' figure comes from the 4,425 repeal and amendment commits, which name the act but carry no Source line or URL.

Shares are of what exists, not of what each repository says it holds; estimates are marked, with their method in [data/completeness.json](../data/completeness.json).
